purpose: Square studio avatar for social profiles and circular crops.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final square profile avatar for Node Studio, a web development and AI studio. Create one finished image, not a mockup or presentation sheet.
Subject: a distinctive minimal four-module studio symbol: exactly four thick softly rounded square tiles in a compact 2 by 2 arrangement, with the top-right tile offset slightly upward. Tilt the entire arrangement about 10 degrees counterclockwise. Keep the symbol highly recognizable at small avatar sizes.
Style: beautifully art-directed, restrained dimensional brand render; satin ceramic / frosted glass tiles, softly beveled edges, subtle material depth and controlled studio reflections. Front-facing, almost orthographic, with a gentle blue-violet glow immediately around the modules. Calm, premium and clean.
Color palette: tiles transition from blue #5286f4 through violet #7963ee to lavender #b08afa. Opaque seamless dark navy-charcoal background close to #10121b, with only a subtle broad soft ambient gradient.
Composition: centered symbol occupies about 55 percent of a square canvas, generous clean dark negative space on every side. Entire symbol must fit comfortably within a circular avatar crop. Background fills every edge; no external app-icon container or outer frame.
Constraints: exactly four square modules; no text, letters, slogans, watermark, extra objects, particle effects, grid, cables or network lines. Keep edges precise and the visual simple. Output a high-resolution square avatar.
